effect: The balance organs now connect to the body's response routes. The result also shows that vision and signals from muscles and joints help with balance.
reaction: Seeing the eyes turn opposite the head makes the purpose of the connections clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance organs to the body was most worthwhile: the final picture shows how their signals help keep the eyes on a fixed point and adjust posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the response routes to the body felt a little repetitive because the sensors still had to be fitted afterward, although the pale spaces made that clear.

surprise.text: The weighted layer shifts not just with tilt but also when straight-line movement changes. The picture helped explain what the crystals do.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though joining the two sensor types was a compatible pairing rather than a discovery of how they fit together.

continue.text: Yes. I would try another chapter because seeing separate sensors and nerve routes combine into a visible response was satisfying.
